scripts.typecheck: vue-tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.deploy: node scripts/validate-deploy.mjs && pnpm db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages tests scripts *.mjs *.ts *.json *.jsonc *.yaml docs README.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Independent application signing secret, at least 32 random characters.

BOOTSTRAP_SECRET.description: One-time Owner initialization secret, at least 32 random characters. Remove after setup.

PROVIDER_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Independent 32-byte base64 Garmin token encryption key; keep a backup.

GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY.description: Only required for personal_api mode; never sent to the browser.

GARMIN_PASSWORD.description: Only required for credentials mode; raw string stored as a Worker Secret.
